latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the assigned investigator stage. One native Goal was created with the frozen objective, the binding guard passed, and that same Goal was completed. The activation and completion responses are saved in [native-goal-active.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P01-treatment/run/B11-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/native-goal-active.json) and [native-goal-terminal.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P01-treatment/run/B11-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/native-goal-terminal.json).

The brief-only discovery was frozen before the one-shot plan release; its recorded hash matches. The stage outputs are [discovery.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P01-treatment/run/B11-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/discovery.md), [draft.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P01-treatment/run/B11-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/draft.md), [source-map.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P01-treatment/run/B11-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/source-map.json), and [sources/index.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P01-treatment/run/B11-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/sources/index.md). The released plan is preserved at [revealed-plan.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P01-treatment/run/B11-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/revealed-plan.md).

No application code or tests were run; the draft separates proposed validation from executed artifact checks.
